==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''FZZF''' is an acronym of his Chinese ID "风中追风" (Fēng zhōng zhuī fēng), which means "Chasing Wind."
* Has the nickname "Curly Hair" due to the fact he had curly hair earlier in his gaming career.
* Was once considered one of the best two supports in China alongside [[lovelin]].
* Rejected a female fan's confession in LPL because he "wants to focus on gaming first."
* Known for playing unconventional supports such as {{ci|Elise}}, {{ci|Syndra}}, and even {{ci|Twisted Fate}}.
